data.name: BeamMaxx: Push or Get Pushed
data.detailed_description:
⚡ BeamMaxx ⚡

Get absolutely dominated by colorful beams in intense tug-of-war combat you didn't know you needed.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

THE PREMISE IS SIMPLE. THE EXECUTION? NOT SO MUCH.

Push your opponent's beam off their edge before they push yours.

That's it. That's the game.

Except there are 3 lanes. And a timing-based power system.

And opponents that get faster, smarter, and more aggressive.

Oh, and if you mess up the bonus timing? You're fighting at a disadvantage.

Welcome to BeamMaxx. You will get pushed. A lot.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

⚡ CORE MECHANICS (AKA HOW YOU'LL LOSE)

🎯 3-LANE BATTLEFIELD

Switch lanes to dodge. Or don't. Get pushed anyway.

Strategic positioning? Sure. Panic button-mashing? Also works (sometimes).

⏱️ TIMING-BASED BONUS SYSTEM

Hit the PERFECT zone (90-95% on the countdown bar) = massive power boost

Hit the sweet spot (85-90%) = decent bonus

Miss completely? Enjoy getting absolutely mogged by your opponent

💥 PURE SKILL-BASED COMBAT

No RNG. No excuses. Just you vs the arena.

If you lose, it's because you got outplayed. Simple as.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🏆 TWO MODES TO PROVE YOURSELF (OR NOT)

TOURNAMENT MODE - The Gauntlet

- Face 5 increasingly difficult AI opponents

- Best of 3 rounds per match

- Each opponent is faster and smarter than the last

- Progressive difficulty curve = you WILL improve (or quit)

- Beat all 5 = Achievement unlocked + bragging rights

INFINITE SURVIVAL - How Long Can You Last?

- Endless waves of opponents

- 3 lives. Make them count.

- Difficulty increases with every win

- Chase the high score

- Question your life choices around opponent #15

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

⚡ 6 BEAMS - CHOOSE YOUR SUFFERING

Each beam has unique power/bonus stats. Pick your playstyle:

🔴 RED BEAM (Beam 1)

Power: 18 | Bonus: 4

Balanced. Reliable. The "I don't know what I'm doing yet" choice.

🟠 ORANGE BEAM (Beam 2)

Power: 17 | Bonus: 5

Strategic. Rewards good timing. For players who can hit the perfect zone.

🔵 BLUE BEAM (Beam 3)

Power: 16 | Bonus: 6

Timing-focused. High skill ceiling. For masochists who love pressure.

🟢 GREEN BEAM (Beam 4)

Power: 19 | Bonus: 3

Heavy hitter. Less reliant on timing. Button-mashing approved.

🟠 ORANGE BLAZE (Beam 5)

Power: 20 | Bonus: 2

Raw power. Minimal bonus. For players who don't need help (allegedly).

🩷 PINK BEAM (Beam 6)

Power: 21 | Bonus: 1

Maximum power. Near-zero bonus. Pure aggression. No safety net.

Pick one. Master them all. Get the achievements. Flex.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🎮 WHAT YOU'RE ACTUALLY GETTING

✓ Fast rounds (30-60 seconds) - Perfect for "one more match" syndrome

✓ Skill-based combat - No RNG, no excuses, git gud

✓ Two game modes - Structured progression + endless grind

✓ 6 unique beams - Different strategies, same pain

✓ Timing mini-game - High risk, high reward, high blood pressure

✓ 12 Steam achievements - Proof you suffered

✓ Retro pixel art - Nostalgic rectangles that will dominate you

✓ Dynamic soundtrack - Energetic music to drown out your tears

✓ Steam Cloud Saves - Your shame follows you everywhere

✓ Customizable controls - Because blaming the controls is easier

✓ Instant restarts - No loading screens = no time to reconsider

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🏅 ACHIEVEMENTS (COPE COLLECTION)

TOURNAMENT MASTERY

Complete Tournament with each of the 6 beams.

Yes, all of them. Yes, even Pink Beam.

INFINITE LEGENDS

- First Blood - Defeat 1 opponent (tutorial difficulty)

- Rising Star - Defeat 5 opponents (starting to feel confident)

- Veteran Fighter - Defeat 10 opponents (confidence shattered)

- Unstoppable - Defeat 15 opponents (how are you still alive)

- Legend - Defeat 20 opponents (actual skill or luck?)

- Immortal - Defeat 25 opponents (touch grass)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

💪 BUILT FOR PLAYERS WHO

- Enjoy skill-based challenges without hand-holding

- Appreciate fast-paced arcade action

- Chase high scores and achievements compulsively

- Don't mind getting absolutely demolished (repeatedly)

- Keep saying "one more match" at 3 AM

- Respect the grind

Not built for players who need tutorials, auto-aim, or participation trophies.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

⚡ THE BOTTOM LINE ⚡

Easy to learn. Impossible to master. Addictive as hell.

Simple controls. Deep mechanics. Pure skill expression.

You'll lose. You'll retry. You'll improve. You'll lose again.

But eventually—EVENTUALLY—you'll dominate.

Or you'll uninstall and write a negative review. Either way.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

The arena is waiting.

The beams are charged.

Your timing is probably off.

Will you maximize your potential?

Or stay mid-tier forever?

⚡ BeamMaxx - Push or Get Pushed ⚡

  • Sound Card: Any
